notes: NEIGHBORHOOD CORRECTION: the stored neighborhood 'Rancho Bernardo' is not quite right. Duff's Doggz has only one location — confirmed via Google Business ('Closed... Opens 10 AM'), the chain's own site copy ('we cook up... wieners and bratwursts seven days a week at our Carmel Mountain location'), and DoorDash/UberEats, all giving the same single address: 12047 Carmel Mountain Rd, San Diego, CA 92128, inside the Carmel Mountain Ranch Home Center (next to Home Depot). That is the Carmel Mountain Ranch neighborhood, adjacent to but distinct from Rancho Bernardo. Pricing is sourced primarily from the restaurant's own website (duffsdoggz.com), which publishes a live price on each item's individual page (e.g. /items/chicago-style-dogg) even though the general /menu overview page itself is JS-lazy-loaded and renders empty. Uber Eats' listing for this restaurant is stale/wrong — it shows 'Closed on Uber Eats as of Jun 17, 2022' with no prices, so it was not used. The full menu also includes many condiment/topping add-ons (extra lobster, side sauces, bottled beverages, bagged chips/candy) and merchandise (t-shirts) which were left out as not being dishes. Drink and side prices beyond 'Chips' ($1.00, a base snack-bag price) could not be confirmed from either source without guessing, so they were omitted rather than invented.
